# Ostoslista Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A native iOS shopping list app (one flat list, local SwiftData persistence, Finnish UI) built from spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-16-ostoslista-design.md`.

**Architecture:** Single SwiftUI app target + XCTest unit-test target, generated by XcodeGen from `project.yml`. One `@Model` class (`ShoppingItem`), pure sorting/validation helpers (`ShoppingListLogic`) tested without UI, one screen (`ShoppingListView`).

**Tech Stack:** Swift 5.9, SwiftUI, SwiftData, XcodeGen 2.45.4, xcodebuild + iOS Simulator.

## Global Constraints

- Deployment target: **iOS 17.0**, iPhone only (`TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY: 1`).
- UI copy is **Finnish**: "Lisää tuote…", "Tyhjennä ostetut", app title "Ostoslista".
- Bundle id: `fi.maaranen.ostoslista`.
- `xcode-select` points at CommandLineTools on this machine — **every** `xcodebuild`/`xcrun` call must be prefixed with `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer`.
- XcodeGen binary (brew link is broken): `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/xcodegen/2.45.4/bin/xcodegen`.
- The generated `Ostoslista.xcodeproj` is gitignored; only `project.yml` + sources are committed.
- No third-party dependencies.

### Task 2: ShoppingListLogic with TDD

**Files:**
- Create: `Ostoslista/ShoppingListLogic.swift`
- Modify: `OstoslistaTests/ShoppingListLogicTests.swift` (replace placeholder entirely)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ShoppingItem` from Task 1 (`init(name:isDone:createdAt:)`, properties `name`, `isDone`, `createdAt`).
- Produces: `enum ShoppingListLogic` with static funcs used by Task 3:
  - `normalized(_ raw: String) -> String?` — trimmed input or nil when empty
  - `sorted(_ items: [ShoppingItem]) -> [ShoppingItem]` — unchecked first, then oldest first
  - `checked(_ items: [ShoppingItem]) -> [ShoppingItem]` — only checked items, original order

- [ ] **Step 1: Replace test file with failing tests**

Replace the full contents of `OstoslistaTests/ShoppingListLogicTests.swift`:

```swift
import XCTest
@testable import Ostoslista

final class ShoppingListLogicTests: XCTestCase {
    func testNormalizedTrimsWhitespace() {
        XCTAssertEqual(ShoppingListLogic.normalized("  maito \n"), "maito")
    }

    func testNormalizedRejectsEmptyInput() {
        XCTAssertNil(ShoppingListLogic.normalized(""))
        XCTAssertNil(ShoppingListLogic.normalized("   \n\t"))
    }

    func testSortedPutsUncheckedFirstThenOldestFirst() {
        let bread  = ShoppingItem(name: "leipä", isDone: true,  createdAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1))
        let milk   = ShoppingItem(name: "maito", isDone: false, createdAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 3))
        let coffee = ShoppingItem(name: "kahvi", isDone: false, createdAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 2))
        let result = ShoppingListLogic.sorted([bread, milk, coffee])
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.name), ["kahvi", "maito", "leipä"])
    }

    func testCheckedReturnsOnlyCheckedItems() {
        let bread = ShoppingItem(name: "leipä", isDone: true)
        let milk  = ShoppingItem(name: "maito", isDone: false)
        XCTAssertEqual(ShoppingListLogic.checked([bread, milk]).map(\.name), ["leipä"])
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `Ostoslista/ShoppingListLogic.swift`**

```swift
import Foundation

enum ShoppingListLogic {
    /// Trimmed input, or nil when nothing remains.
    static func normalized(_ raw: String) -> String? {
        let trimmed = raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        return trimmed.isEmpty ? nil : trimmed
    }

    /// Unchecked first; within each group oldest first.
    static func sorted(_ items: [ShoppingItem]) -> [ShoppingItem] {
        items.sorted {
            if $0.isDone != $1.isDone { return !$0.isDone }
            return $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt
        }
    }

    static func checked(_ items: [ShoppingItem]) -> [ShoppingItem] {
        items.filter(\.isDone)
    }
}
```

### Task 3: ShoppingListView — the real screen

**Files:**
- Modify: `Ostoslista/ShoppingListView.swift` (replace stub entirely)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ShoppingItem` (Task 1); `ShoppingListLogic.normalized/sorted/checked` (Task 2).
- Produces: the final UI; nothing downstream.

- [ ] **Step 1: Replace `Ostoslista/ShoppingListView.swift` with the full screen**

```swift
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct ShoppingListView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var modelContext
    @Query private var items: [ShoppingItem]
    @State private var newItemName = ""
    @FocusState private var inputFocused: Bool

    private var sortedItems: [ShoppingItem] { ShoppingListLogic.sorted(items) }
    private var checkedCount: Int { ShoppingListLogic.checked(items).count }

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            List {
                Section {
                    TextField("Lisää tuote…", text: $newItemName)
                        .focused($inputFocused)
                        .submitLabel(.done)
                        .onSubmit(addItem)
                }
                if !items.isEmpty {
                    Section {
                        ForEach(sortedItems) { item in
                            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                                Image(systemName: item.isDone ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                                    .foregroundStyle(item.isDone ? Color.green : Color.secondary)
                                Text(item.name)
                                    .strikethrough(item.isDone)
                                    .foregroundStyle(item.isDone ? .secondary : .primary)
                            }
                            .contentShape(Rectangle())
                            .onTapGesture { item.isDone.toggle() }
                        }
                        .onDelete(deleteItems)
                    } header: {
                        Text("\(checkedCount) / \(items.count)")
                    }
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle("Ostoslista")
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
                    Button("Tyhjennä ostetut", action: clearChecked)
                        .disabled(checkedCount == 0)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func addItem() {
        guard let name = ShoppingListLogic.normalized(newItemName) else { return }
        modelContext.insert(ShoppingItem(name: name))
        newItemName = ""
        inputFocused = true
    }

    private func deleteItems(at offsets: IndexSet) {
        let current = sortedItems
        for index in offsets { modelContext.delete(current[index]) }
    }

    private func clearChecked() {
        for item in ShoppingListLogic.checked(items) { modelContext.delete(item) }
    }
}
```
